Sai Sri Sakshit Allumolu and several others, 🚀 Slack MCP is now LIVE on Dayton! 🚀 Hey Team, Slack MCP integration is now available and ready to use in Dayton! 🎉 🛠️ Setup (takes less than a minute) Run: dayton update Start Dayton: (make sure that your dayton tokens is set and not expired) dayton Enable the Slack MCP in the TUI (press 4 for MCP options). Hit Shift + L (or start Dayton as you normally would). ✅ That's it! Dayton can now send you notifications directly on Slack.
💡 When is this useful? Running multiple Dayton sessions simultaneously Long-running tasks that don't require you to watch the terminal Working away from your machine while Dayton continues processing PR reviews, refactors, migrations, or any task where you just want a completion notification ✨ How to use it Simply add something like "notify me on Slack" or "let me know on Slack" to your prompt. Examples: Refactor all usages of the legacy DataFetcher class to use the new ApiClient. When complete, send me a Slack notification listing all files changed. Review this PR and let me know on Slack when the review is complete. No more babysitting terminals 👀 — let Dayton do the work and Slack will let you know when it's done. 🔔 Feel free to try it out and share feedback! at slack-connect-mcp Currently Notification slack mobile notification slack message notification only supported and support for asking Permissions and Confirmations ✅ ❌ COMING SOON
